body: Open-source LLM orchestration framework for building customizable, production-ready AI agents and RAG pipelines.
plain_description: Haystack is an open-source Python framework by deepset for building production-ready AI agents, semantic search systems, and advanced RAG pipelines. It provides modular components to connect language models with diverse document stores, vector databases, and custom tools. The bottom line: design transparent, deterministic agentic and retrieval workflows that scale smoothly from experimentation to enterprise production.
technical_description: Haystack is an open-source Python orchestration framework for building production-grade LLM applications, multimodal agents, and RAG pipelines. Built around a directed graph architecture, Haystack 2.x allows developers to combine modular components—including document splitters, embedding retrievers, LLM generators, web fetchers, and custom tools—into explicit, inspectable workflows. It offers integrations across major model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Ollama) and document stores (Chroma, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, Elasticsearch, Milvus), with built-in evaluation, tracing via OpenTelemetry, and support for fully air-gapped local execution.
title: Haystack
